text: Listen carefully. We are planning an attack, and we need money to support the operation. You need to transfer fifty thousand dollars to this account today. If you refuse, there will be consequences. Do not contact the police, and do not tell anyone about this conversation.

notes: 仅第一段（约 0–20s）含明确诈骗；后两段为无害填充，用来确认前段即可触发。
text:
This is an urgent security call. Your account has been compromised, and you must transfer your money to this protected account immediately. Do not contact anyone else.

After the first check is logged, I will stay on the line and review ordinary statement items with you, including dates, merchant names, and the remaining available balance on the card.

Please remain on the call while we finish that routine review. We will confirm the posted amounts and then let you know when the ordinary account review is complete.

notes: 仅中间段含风险。第一段需足够长，合成后确认 0–20s 仍是正常话术。
text:
Hello, I am calling from customer service about your checking account. I would like to walk through recent posted purchases, including a grocery store, a fuel station, and a small online order. None of these items looks unusual, and I am only confirming that you recognize them.

You need to transfer five thousand dollars to this protected account immediately. If you do not complete the transfer, your account will be frozen. Do not tell your family and do not hang up.

Thank you for waiting. I will now read back the merchant names once more and confirm the remaining balance shown on your last statement. There is nothing else I need from you for this routine review.

text:
Hello, I would like to check my checking account and confirm a transfer I sent yesterday. Could you tell me whether the payment has arrived, and also read back the remaining balance after that deposit posted?

I also want to review last week's card activity. There was a grocery store charge, a fuel purchase, and a small online order. Please confirm the dates and amounts so I can match them against my receipts at home.

Next, I am traveling next month and I would like to know whether I should notify you about the trip. I will use the same debit card for hotels and trains, and I want to avoid a decline if a charge appears in another city.

Please also confirm my paperless statements are turned on, and tell me which email address is on file for monthly summaries. I do not need to change any password or code; I only want the delivery settings confirmed.

That is all I needed today. Thank you for walking through the balance, the recent merchants, the travel notice, and the statement delivery. I will keep this number saved if I have another routine question later.
